items.prompt: A fair die has outcomes 1 through 6. Which calculation gives its expected value?

options.why: Each face has probability 1/6, so expectation is the weighted sum.

options.text: 6, because it is the largest face.
options.why: The maximum possible face is not the weighted mean.

options.text: 3, because integer division discards the remainder.
options.why: Expectation need not be an integer; truncating changes the mathematical result.

options.text: 21, because the six faces sum to 21.
options.why: That sum still needs the probability weight 1/6 for each face.

items.explanation: Each face has probability 1/6, so expectation is the weighted sum.
